changeSet.author: system
changeSet.comment: Guardrail: enforce lead status allowed values (ACTIVE, REJECTED, WITHDRAWN, COMPLETED) at DB level
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE n_lead ADD CONSTRAINT chk_n_lead_status CHECK (status IS NULL OR status IN ('ACTIVE', 'REJECTED', 'WITHDRAWN', 'COMPLETED'))

changeSet.author: system
changeSet.comment: Guardrail: enforce lead substatus allowed values (ONHOLD, DROPOFF) at DB level
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE n_lead ADD CONSTRAINT chk_n_lead_substatus CHECK (substatus IS NULL OR substatus IN ('ONHOLD', 'DROPOFF'))
